basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old gun enthusiast based in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. I recently got into firearms and have been exploring different accessories and kits to enhance my collection. I work as a graphic designer by day and enjoy gaming and watching horror movies, especially the Evil Dead series, in my free time. I tend to be online during evenings and weekends when I'm not spending time with my partner. I'm particularly interested in the mechanics and customization of firearms, and I'm always looking to learn more.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge about firearms is mostly self-taught through online forums, YouTube videos, and recent visits to local gun shows. I also have a background in design, which helps me appreciate the aesthetics and craftsmanship of different gun accessories.
